origin.description: A glm link whose mean is kept away from the boundary.
origin.details: A glm link whose mean is kept away from the boundary.
origin.value: A link list. linkfun is the bounded transform.
origin.example:
suppressPackageStartupMessages(library(survival))
value <- (function() {
  link <- blog()
  mu <- c(0.01, 0.2, 0.5, 0.9, 0.99)
  c(link$name, sprintf("%.17g", link$linkfun(mu)))
})()
cat(paste(value, collapse = "\n"), "\n", sep = "")

translation.description: A glm link whose mean is kept away from the boundary.
translation.details: A glm link whose mean is kept away from the boundary.
translation.value: A link list. linkfun is the bounded transform.
translation.example:
from survival import blog

def one():
    link = blog()
    mu = [0.01, 0.2, 0.5, 0.9, 0.99]
    return [link["name"], *[f"{value:.17g}" for value in link["linkfun"](mu)]]

print("\n".join(one()))
